mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% signals severe labor market distress, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 10.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in payrolls signals accelerating economic deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (returns positive >55% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: Early recovery phase (GDPC1 growth turns positive after two consecutive negative quarters) signals economic rebound, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: early recovery phase (GDPC1 growth turns positive after two negative quarters)
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods matching the early recovery regime definition.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained increase in industrial production signals strengthening corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO rises for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 3.0% per annum signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 600,000 units per month signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in housing starts (HOUST > 600,000) and industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals broad-based economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 600.0 and INDPRO > 100 fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases (returns negative >55% of instances).
